painPoints.title: Slow order processing and fulfillment
painPoints.description: Manual order entry, tracking, and shipping processes lead to delays.

painPoints.title: Inaccurate inventory management and stock levels
painPoints.description: Disconnected systems and manual processes result in frequent inventory errors.

painPoints.title: Siloed transportation and logistics data
painPoints.description: Disparate systems prevent end-to-end visibility and optimization of logistics operations.

painPoints.title: Inefficient fleet management and asset utilization
painPoints.description: Manual planning and scheduling lead to underutilized vehicles and resources.

painPoints.title: Compliance and regulatory reporting challenges
painPoints.description: Fragmented data and manual processes hinder timely reporting and auditing.

painPoints.title: Repetitive and time-consuming documentation tasks
painPoints.description: Paperwork-intensive processes like invoicing, customs clearance, and claims management.

painPoints.title: Ineffective customer communication and transparency
painPoints.description: Lack of real-time order and shipment updates leads to dissatisfied customers.

painPoints.title: Suboptimal route planning and delivery scheduling
painPoints.description: Manual planning results in longer routes, higher fuel costs, and missed deliveries.

painPoints.title: Inaccurate financial reporting and cost allocation
painPoints.description: Disconnected systems and manual processes hinder visibility into logistics costs.

painPoints.title: High rate of delivery exceptions and returns
painPoints.description: Lack of end-to-end visibility and coordination leads to more delivery issues.
